---
title: "Sowing calendar"
---

When to start each plant indoors (northern hemisphere).

| Month | Sow |
|---|---|
| Jan–Feb | Chives, parsley |
| Mar–Apr | Basil, tomato |
| May–Jun | Mint cuttings, lettuce |
| Sep–Oct | Lettuce, rosemary cuttings |

::: {.callout-note}
This table is plain Markdown. Quarto adds the styling, the search-friendly layout, and a
light/dark switch (top right).
:::
